title: Lonesome Dove
author: Larry McMurtry
summary: Two retired Texas Rangers decide to drive a herd of cattle from the Rio Grande to Montana. Their journey is full of old friends, hard characters and dangers that wear the men down.
readIf: you want a vast, character-rich Western that is part adventure and part elegy for a fading way of life.
skipIf: you want a short book or a clean, heroic Western; it is long, brutal and often bleakly funny.

pairings.reason: A far harsher and more mythic Western that strips away every romantic idea about the frontier.
Another long American journey of endurance, though about families in poverty instead of cowboys.
A slower, more lyrical travel story about a man crossing a ravaged landscape toward home.
